security_privacy.name: Security & Privacy

mandatory_sections: Threat Model and System Assumptions (Attacker Goals, Capabilities, Knowledge)
Security & Privacy Formal Analysis (Guarantee, Bounds, or Leakage Proofs)
Empirical Attack / Defense Evaluation under Varied Adversarial Budgets

preferred_plots.description: Privacy Budget / Adversarial Ratio vs. Accuracy
Detection True Positive Rate vs False Positive Rate
Defense Utility under Varied Attack Strengths

security_privacy.causal_mechanism_focus: Explain how the defense bound bounds the adversarial gradient perturbation, or how cryptographic blinding masks intermediate states without introducing irreducible utility degradation.

distributed_systems.name: Computer Systems & Distributed Computing

mandatory_sections: Hardware Testbed and Workload Specification (Cluster setup, traces)
Throughput, Scalability, and Tail Latency Evaluation
eval_metrics: Resource Utilization (CPU, GPU, Memory, Network Bandwidth)

preferred_plots.description: CDF of Request Latencies comparing P50 and P99 tail
Throughput and Speedup as node count scales from 1 to N

distributed_systems.causal_mechanism_focus: Map performance speedups to hardware bottleneck alleviation (e.g. eliminating lock contention, zero-copy serialization, or overlapping communication with computation).

machine_learning_fl.name: Machine Learning & Federated Learning Algorithms

mandatory_sections: Problem Formulation and Optimization Objective (Decoupled client/server loss)
Algorithmic Pseudocode (Algorithm 1 with ClientUpdate and ServerAggregation)
Multi-seed Convergence, Heterogeneity Resilience, and Ablation Study

preferred_plots.description: Multi-seed Convergence Curves with std variance shading
Component Ablation across diverse data distributions (Non-IID alpha=0.1, 0.5)
Performance Variance across heterogeneous neural network architectures

machine_learning_fl.causal_mechanism_focus: Attribute accuracy gains to regularizer penalization of representation drift, dynamic prompt adaptation, or gradient orthogonalization across local optimization steps.

nlp_llm.name: Natural Language Processing & Large Language Models

mandatory_sections: Benchmark Evaluation Setup (MMLU, GSM8K, HumanEval, MT-Bench)
Human Evaluation or LLM-as-a-Judge Protocol and Agreement Rate
eval_metrics: Win Rate vs GPT-4 / SOTA baselines

preferred_plots.description: Accuracy vs Inference FLOPs / Parameter Size Trade-off
Multi-dimension Capability Radar (Math, Code, Reasoning, Safety)
Pass@1 benchmark comparisons across model sizes

nlp_llm.causal_mechanism_focus: Explain how Chain-of-Thought routing, preference optimization, or dynamic token selection reduces error propagation across multi-step generative horizons.

llm_agent_security.name: LLM & Agent Security

mandatory_sections: Threat Model (attacker position: direct vs. indirect injection, capabilities, knowledge, goals)
Attack or Defense Design with explicit trust boundaries
Evaluation on public benchmarks with adaptive attacks

preferred_plots.description: ASR and utility per model / defense
Security vs. utility (ASR vs. benign task success)
ASR per attack type x target model

llm_agent_security.causal_mechanism_focus: Explain which trust boundary the attack crosses or the defense enforces (instruction/data separation, privilege isolation, provenance checks) and why the mechanism survives adaptive attackers.
